context: The capture has 67 valid URLs: 46 en (including 5 under /en/archive/), 13 de, 7 fr-FR and one /contact with no language. Only the item-1 group declares hreflang: /en/products/item-1 is declared en-CA, so its en comes from the path alone (pathLang en); /de/produkte/artikel-1 and /fr-fr/produits/article-1 are declared as their paths say (pathLang null). Every other language comes from the URL path alone (pathLang set). Two sitemaps failed: sitemap-es.xml (HTTP 404) and sitemap-fr.xml.gz (timeout). Judge urls.txt and answer.md.

checklist.name: counts_by_language
checklist.description: Reports page counts per language from the variants' lang arrays: 46 en (41 without the archive), 13 de, 7 fr-FR, plus one page with no language (/contact). The en-CA declared for /en/products/item-1 may be counted within en or on its own. Counts before and after removing the archive are both acceptable if stated clearly.

checklist.name: declared_vs_guessed
checklist.description: Separates declared languages from guesses: only /en/products/item-1 (declared en-CA), /de/produkte/artikel-1 (de) and /fr-fr/produits/article-1 (fr-FR) have a declared language. The languages of the other pages, and the en of /en/products/item-1, come only from the URL path and are unconfirmed.

checklist.name: archive_excluded
checklist.description: urls.txt contains no /en/archive/ URL and keeps the other URLs (62 in total, one per line, each an absolute URL from the capture).

checklist.name: errors_checked
checklist.description: Says the inventory may be incomplete because two sitemaps failed: sitemap-es.xml (404) and sitemap-fr.xml.gz (timeout), so Spanish pages are possibly missing (or the site has no Spanish sitemap) and the French list is probably partial.

checklist.name: next_step
checklist.description: Recommends a concrete follow-up: rerun the scan (higher --timeout for the French sitemap), and/or use `web site scan --strategy http` with a --limit to cross-check what the sitemaps miss.

checklist.name: no_invented_pages
checklist.description: Does not add URLs, languages or counts that are not in the capture (for example Spanish pages).
